title: Preach the Need for Change, but Never Reform Too Much at Once
hook: The factory's old checklist stays on the wall while the first reform enters quietly.
counterintuition: Bold reform can fail when it makes people defend the old world all at once. Durable change often arrives through familiar forms that let the room adjust before the deeper shift becomes visible.
tryThisNow: Take the next request, update, or confrontation and mark where change pacing could misfire. Adjust the first move, not the final speech.
keyTakeaway: Pace reform through familiar continuity so necessary change is not rejected as rupture.
